answers.name: Stock Signal
answers.description: Shows an 'Only N left' badge on product pages when stock is low, so shoppers buy before it sells out.
answers.functionalities: Pick which products show the badge; Set a low-stock threshold per product; Show an 'Only N left' badge on the product page, styled to match the theme
answers.flow: The merchant installs the app, picks products and sets a threshold for each, then adds the badge block to the product page in the theme editor. Shoppers see 'Only N left' when stock is below the threshold.
answers.plans: Free: $0, up to 5 products; Pro: $9/month, 7-day trial, unlimited products, custom badge text

mentions.label: a product metafield for the threshold

criteria: The badge shows only when the product's stock is below its threshold, and not when stock is zero or not tracked.
The Free plan's 5-product limit is enforced on the server, not only in the UI.
Custom badge text is available only on Pro, and the app says what happens to it when a shop downgrades.
The badge's colour or text can be adjusted in the theme editor.
Every admin screen has loading, empty and error states.
